rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: DOTrames
Exhibition name: Coral Fiesta ®
rows.Bloom: Orange-red to vermilion. None / no fragrance. 40 to 45 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Very large, very full (41+ petals), exhibition, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, dense. Large, matte, dark green foliage.

Height: 4' to 5' (120 to 150cm). Width: up to 4' (up to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Notes: Rose Barni describes Coral Fiesta as being coral in the bud and then passing to vermilion in the open flower.
